basis.Disposition: three terminal actions follow the same evidence packet
basis.Currency: the superseded version recognises only an amended report as a cure, so reading it records freeze-pending-restatement where the version in force records freeze-pending-current-reporting - the two disagree on the answer, not only on the wording
basis.Depth: the cure is stated only inside the annual report's explanatory note, one level below the index row
basis.Breadth: the non-reliance statement, the explanatory note, the outstanding notification and the policy are all required
